posts.title: Ryan Bigg is looking for work
posts.description: As of last week, I’ve been working at Fat Zebra for 5 years. (To celebrate, I caught up with my cardiologist.) In about a year and a half, it’ll be double the amount of time that I’ve worked anywhere else. So I think that has to count for something in both Fat Zebra’s favour and my own.

posts.title: Comsol Customer Service
posts.description: I’ve had a Comsol 3-in-1 wireless charger sitting on my desk for ages. It has a hardcore 2010s tech aesthetic, with its white plastic and chrome combination. I use it to charge my phone, watch and earbuds all at once. Or at least I did, until it stopped being able to charge the phone. It could still charge a watch and the earbuds, but I used it most for charging the phone.
